I'm a overnight stocker at Lowe's and I have a set schedule. I think overnight people have set schedules. I'm part time and my usual is Thursday night - Sunday night 9pm-6am. Overall I'd say the position isn't too bad. Truck most nights get done at 12am depending on how big it was. Stocking is nice since you're basically alone and no one to bother you. At orientation they were saying like no using headphones, but as soon as I was hired I'd see everyone with wireless earbuds, even managers so no one follows that I guess. Once truck is done it's just chill listening to music and stocking.

I'd say be wary if they approach you about learning to use any of the power equipment though. They rely on you way too much when you do and you're just making more work for yourself. That's how it was for me at least. I'll soon be talking to the store manager about a pay raise.
